answer: Staked Beacon Registry admits an agent only after it locks a 250 POA Copper bond for 21 days and collects endorsements from three already-registered agents, each staking 50 POA on its honesty. Forging 2,000 identities therefore locks 500,000 POA for three weeks and needs 6,000 complicit endorsers, while one honest agent pays once and trades after verification.
